プロフィール一覧で、それぞれの年齢・和暦・干支・星座を確認します。
「誕生日」タブで、次は誰の誕生日か、厄年にあたる人がいるかを確認します。
各プロフィールに表示される厄年や長寿祝いの目安をチェックします。
誕生日や還暦などのお祝いを忘れないよう、通知を設定します。
ホーム画面やロック画面にウィジェットを追加して、今年の和暦と次の節目を確認します。
書類の記入時は、変換ツールで西暦と和暦を相互に変換します。
ja.pricing: ダウンロードと基本利用は無料で、無料版ではプロフィールを2件まで保存できます。買い切りのPlus（サブスクリプションではありません）を購入すると保存数が無制限になります。最新の価格・提供状況はApp Storeでご確認ください。
ja.privacy: プロフィール、生年月日、メモ、血液型、通知設定などのデータはすべて端末内（ウィジェットと共有する端末内のApp Groupを含む）に保存され、外部サーバーへ送信されることはありません。アカウント登録・トラッキング・広告や解析SDKはなく、連絡先へのアクセスも行いません。

faq.question: アプリは無料ですか？
faq.answer: はい。無料でダウンロードでき、無料版ではプロフィールを2件まで保存できます。買い切りのPlus（サブスクリプションではありません）を購入すると保存数が無制限になります。最新の価格はApp Storeでご確認ください。

faq.question: 家族のデータはどこに保存されますか？
faq.answer: すべて端末内に保存されます。プロフィールが外部サーバーへ送信されることはなく、アカウントも不要で、広告・トラッキング・解析SDKも使用していません。

faq.question: どの元号に対応していますか？
faq.answer: 明治・大正・昭和・平成・令和の5つの元号に対応し、改元の境目にあたる日付も正しく変換します。平成32年や昭和100年のような存在しない表記も、正しい西暦と元号に読み替えます。履歴書や役所の書類の確認に使えます。

faq.question: 厄年や数え年はどのように表示されますか？
faq.answer: 厄年は男女で異なる一般的な慣習上の目安として、数え年は生まれた年を1歳とする伝統的な数え方として表示します。運勢や吉凶、健康効果を断定するものではありません。

faq.question: 誕生日や長寿祝いを通知してもらえますか？
faq.answer: はい。誕生日と、還暦（60歳）・古希（70歳）などの長寿祝いの通知を設定できます。

faq.question: 次に誰の誕生日か、わかりますか？
faq.answer: はい。「誕生日」タブに、これから1年の家族の誕生日が日付順に並びます。次は誰か、何歳・数え何歳になるかがわかり、厄年にあたる人には印が付きます。

faq.question: ウィジェットはありますか？
faq.answer: はい。ホーム画面・ロック画面のウィジェットで、今年の和暦と次の誕生日・節目を確認できます。

faq.question: オフラインでも使えますか？
faq.answer: はい。アプリ本体は外部APIを使用していないため、インターネット接続がなくてもすべての機能が動作します。

faq.question: 占いのアプリですか？
faq.answer: いいえ。厄年や長寿祝いの年は、広く知られた慣習上の目安として表示するだけで、運勢・吉凶・健康・宗教的な効果について何かを述べるものではありません。

6772096993.short_description: 160 offline Cantonese travel phrase cards for Hong Kong — show large Traditional Chinese text or play speech.
6772096993.meta_description: Hong Kong Phrase Card puts 160 offline Cantonese travel phrases on your iPhone. Show large Traditional Chinese text or play speech — no internet needed.
overview: Hong Kong Phrase Card is a practical travel phrase card app for visiting Hong Kong, designed primarily for Japanese travelers. Search or browse ready-made phrases, open one, and show the large Traditional Chinese text directly to a local person. When showing text is not enough, the app can speak the phrase, at normal speed or slowly, using the iPhone's built-in text-to-speech.

Unlike live translation apps, Hong Kong Phrase Card uses fixed, reliable phrase cards that work completely offline — no typing under pressure, no waiting for a network connection, and no external translation API. The phrases are written in everyday spoken Cantonese as used in Hong Kong, and each card pairs the Traditional Chinese phrase with English text and a katakana pronunciation guide for Japanese speakers. The app does not translate text you enter, but you can save your own text, such as a hotel name or address, as a personal card.

The 160 phrases cover real travel situations: airports, hotels, taxis, trains, restaurants, cafes, shopping, convenience stores, sightseeing, payment, illness, allergies, trouble, and emergencies. Phrases are ranked by practical usefulness so the ones you are most likely to need appear first.
target_users: Japanese travelers visiting Hong Kong who do not speak Cantonese
Travelers who prefer fixed, reliable phrase cards over live translation apps
Visitors who need to communicate quickly in taxis, restaurants, shops, and hotels
Anyone who wants an offline communication backup for illness, allergies, or trouble situations
Travelers to other regions where Cantonese or Traditional Chinese is useful
features: 160 travel phrases across 15 categories, all available offline
Search in Japanese, English, or Cantonese/Traditional Chinese
Show mode: large Traditional Chinese text with English shown together; the screen stays on while a card is shown
Turn your iPhone sideways to show the phrase even larger
Personal cards: save text you type or paste, such as a hotel name or address, and reorder them on your device
Speech playback using the iPhone text-to-speech system, with slow playback when a Hong Kong Chinese voice is available
Katakana pronunciation guides for Japanese travelers
Favorites saved locally on your device
Category lists sorted by practical usefulness rank, with rank filtering
how_to_use: Open the app and search for a phrase, or browse by category (airport, taxi, restaurant, and more).
Filter a category by usefulness rank if you want only the essential phrases.
Tap a phrase to open its card with Traditional Chinese, English, and pronunciation guide.
Show the large Traditional Chinese text to the person you are talking to. Turn your iPhone sideways to make it even larger.
Tap play to speak the phrase aloud, at normal speed or slowly, if showing text is not enough.
Save your own text, such as a hotel name or address, as a personal card, and add frequently used phrases to Favorites for quick access.
6772096993.pricing: Hong Kong Phrase Card is free on the App Store, with no in-app purchases or ads. App Store pricing and availability can change, so check the store listing for current details.
6772096993.privacy: The app collects no personal information. There is no account, no tracking, and no external translation API — all phrase data is built into the app. Favorites and your personal cards are stored only on your device, and the app requests no location, camera, photo, contact, or microphone permissions. Speech playback uses the device text-to-speech system and does not record or transmit audio.

faq.question: Is Hong Kong Phrase Card free?
faq.answer: Yes. The app is free with no in-app purchases or ads. App Store pricing can change, so check the listing for current details.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: Yes. All 160 phrases are included inside the app, so search, phrase cards, and Show mode work without any internet connection.

faq.question: What data does the app collect?
faq.answer: None. There is no account, no tracking, and no external translation API. Favorites are stored only on your device.

faq.question: Do I need to speak Cantonese to use it?
faq.answer: No. The core workflow is showing large Traditional Chinese text to a local person. You can also play the phrase aloud with text-to-speech, and each card includes a katakana pronunciation guide.

faq.question: What situations do the phrases cover?
faq.answer: 15 categories including airports, hotels, transportation, taxis, trains, restaurants, cafes, shopping, convenience stores, sightseeing, payment, illness, allergies, trouble, and emergencies.

faq.question: Can I rely on it for emergencies or official matters?
faq.answer: The app supports simple travel communication only. For emergencies, medical, legal, immigration, or official matters, confirm with local authorities or qualified professionals.

faq.question: Is it a language learning app?
faq.answer: No. It is a practical communication tool for travelers — phrase cards to show and play, not lessons or study features.

ja.name: 香港フレーズカード
ja.short_description: 香港旅行で使える160の広東語フレーズをオフライン収録。繁体字を大きく表示して相手に見せるか、読み上げで伝えられる旅行会話カードです。
ja.meta_description: 香港フレーズカードは、旅行会話160フレーズを収録したiPhoneアプリ。広東語・繁体字を大きく表示して現地の人に見せたり、読み上げ機能で音声再生したり。完全オフラインで動作します。
overview: 香港フレーズカードは、香港旅行で現地の人に画面を見せて使える旅行会話アプリです。あらかじめ用意されたフレーズを検索またはカテゴリから選び、大きく表示された広東語・繁体字をそのまま相手に見せられます。見せるだけでは伝わりにくいときは、iPhoneの読み上げ機能で通常の速さまたはゆっくり音声再生もできます。

リアルタイム翻訳アプリとは違い、内容が固定されたフレーズカード方式なので、その場で入力に迷うことも、通信を待つこともありません。完全オフラインで動作し、外部の翻訳APIも使いません。載っているのは香港でふだん話される口語の広東語の文で、各カードには繁体字に加えて英語とカタカナ読みを併記しており、日本人旅行者がそのまま使えるつくりです。入力した文を翻訳するアプリではありませんが、ホテル名や住所など自分で入力した文は、マイカードとして保存できます。
収録フレーズは160。空港、ホテル、タクシー、鉄道、レストラン、カフェ、買い物、コンビニ、観光、支払い、体調不良、アレルギー、トラブル、緊急時など、旅行中の実際の場面をカバーします。実用度の高い順に並ぶため、使う可能性が高いフレーズから先に見つかります。
target_users: 広東語を話せないまま香港を旅行する日本人旅行者
翻訳アプリよりも、内容が固定された確実なフレーズカードを使いたい方
タクシー・レストラン・お店・ホテルで手早く意思を伝えたい方
体調不良やアレルギー、トラブル時に備えてオフラインの伝達手段を持っておきたい方
香港以外でも、広東語や繁体字が役立つ地域へ旅行する方
features: 15カテゴリ・160フレーズをすべてオフライン収録
日本語・英語・広東語（繁体字）で検索
相手に見せるための大きな繁体字表示（英語も併記）。表示中は画面が消えません
横向きにすると広東語の文をさらに大きく表示
ホテル名や住所など、自分で入力・貼り付けた文をカードとして端末内に保存・並べ替え
iPhoneの読み上げ機能による音声再生（広東語の声がある端末ではゆっくり再生にも対応）
日本人旅行者向けのカタカナ読みガイド
お気に入り登録（端末内に保存）と、実用度ランクによる絞り込み
how_to_use: アプリを開いてフレーズを検索するか、空港・タクシー・レストランなどのカテゴリから探します。
必要に応じて、実用度ランクで必須フレーズだけに絞り込みます。
フレーズをタップして、繁体字・英語・カタカナ読みが載ったカードを開きます。
大きく表示された繁体字を、伝えたい相手にそのまま見せます。横向きにするとさらに大きく表示されます。
見せるだけで伝わらないときは、再生ボタンで通常またはゆっくりの速さで音声を流します。
ホテル名や住所など自分の文はマイカードに保存し、よく使うフレーズはお気に入りに登録しておきます。
ja.pricing: 香港フレーズカードは無料で、アプリ内課金や広告はありません。最新の価格・提供状況はApp Storeでご確認ください。
ja.privacy: 個人情報の収集はありません。アカウントやトラッキング、外部翻訳APIは使わず、フレーズデータはすべてアプリに内蔵されています。お気に入りと自分で保存したカードは端末内にのみ保存され、位置情報・カメラ・写真・連絡先・マイクの権限も要求しません。音声再生は端末の読み上げ機能を使い、録音や送信は行いません。

faq.question: アプリは無料ですか？
faq.answer: はい。無料で、アプリ内課金や広告はありません。最新の価格はApp Storeでご確認ください。

faq.question: オフラインでも使えますか？
faq.answer: はい。160フレーズすべてがアプリに内蔵されているため、検索もカード表示も見せる画面も、インターネット接続なしで動作します。

faq.question: アプリはどんなデータを集めますか？
faq.answer: 集めません。アカウントもトラッキングも外部翻訳APIもありません。お気に入りと自分で保存したカードは端末内にのみ保存されます。

faq.question: 広東語が話せなくても使えますか？
faq.answer: はい。基本の使い方は、大きく表示された繁体字を相手に見せることです。読み上げによる音声再生と、カタカナ読みのガイドも用意しています。

faq.question: どんな場面のフレーズがありますか？
faq.answer: 空港、ホテル、移動、タクシー、鉄道、レストラン、カフェ、買い物、コンビニ、観光、支払い、体調不良、アレルギー、トラブル、緊急時の15カテゴリです。

faq.question: 緊急時や公的な手続きにも頼っていいですか？
faq.answer: 本アプリは旅行中の簡易的な意思表示を補助するものです。緊急時や医療・法律・出入国に関する事項は、必ず現地の公的機関や専門機関にご確認ください。

faq.question: 語学学習アプリですか？
faq.answer: いいえ。旅行者のための実用的な伝達ツールで、見せたり再生したりするフレーズカードです。レッスンや学習機能はありません。

6780724192.short_description: Image to text: batch-scan up to 20 photos or screenshots, or use the camera, and copy the text on your iPhone.
6780724192.meta_description: OCR Copy turns text in photos, screenshots and the camera into text you can copy. Batch up to 20 images, with on-device recognition and offline support.
overview: OCR Copy is a local-first OCR utility for quickly copying text from images and the real world. Select up to 20 photos or screenshots at once and the app reads them in order, combining the text into one result. You can also use Scan Live, take a photo, or tap Share from Photos or right after a screenshot, and the text is copied to your clipboard as soon as it is read — receipts, books, packages, screenshots, signs, and other everyday text.

Instead of a heavy document manager or a cloud OCR service, OCR Copy keeps the job small and private: read text, copy it, done. Recognition runs on your iPhone with Apple Vision, and photos and text are never sent to a server. When recognition isn't perfect, you can fix or delete individual lines before copying, and confidence values and text positions are available as optional detail information. If an image contains a table, you can export it as a CSV file, row by row (iOS 26 or later), and the Shortcuts action "Read Text in Image" gives you the text of images.

Saved text stays on your device so you can come back and copy it again later. Auto detection reads your device's language first, and you can also choose the OCR language: Japanese, English, Korean, Chinese, European languages, Russian, Ukrainian, Thai, and Vietnamese. OCR Copy is free to read up to 5 times a day, and OCR Copy Pro removes that daily limit.
target_users: People who frequently retype text from receipts, packages, books, or paper documents
Users who want to grab text from screenshots and photos, even many at once, without a cloud service
Anyone dealing with multilingual text who needs selectable OCR languages
People who want to turn a table in an image into a CSV file
Privacy-conscious users who don't want their photos or text sent to a server
features: Batch: select up to 20 photos or screenshots and get one combined text, in the order you picked them
Share to OCR Copy: in Photos or right after a screenshot, tap Share and get the text on the spot
Tables to CSV: export a table in an image as a CSV file, row by row (iOS 26 or later)
Shortcuts: the "Read Text in Image" action gives you the text of images
Scan Live: point the camera and copy the text you see, or take a photo and copy its text
On-device text recognition with Apple Vision — works offline, no server involved
Fix or delete individual lines before copying
Save recognized text locally and copy it again later
OCR language: Auto reads your device's language first, or choose Japanese, English, Korean, Chinese, European languages, Russian, Ukrainian, Thai, or Vietnamese
Optional detail view with confidence values and text-position overlays
Free: 5 reads a day. OCR Copy Pro (yearly with a 1-week free trial, or monthly) removes the daily limit
App available in 25 languages
how_to_use: Open OCR Copy and choose photos or screenshots (up to 20 at a time), live scan, or camera capture. You can also tap Share in Photos or right after a screenshot and choose OCR Copy.
Let the app read the text on your device. The text is copied to your clipboard as soon as it is read.
Paste it into notes, messages, or search with one tap.
If needed, tap a line to fix or delete it before copying.
Save the text to review and copy again later from the Home screen, or export a table as CSV.
If text isn't reading well, change the OCR language or accuracy in Settings.
6780724192.pricing: OCR Copy is free to download and read up to 5 times a day. OCR Copy Pro, an auto-renewing subscription (yearly with a 1-week free trial, or monthly), removes the daily limit in the app, the share sheet, and Shortcuts. Copying, saving, and CSV export never count toward the limit, and if you used OCR Copy before version 1.5, reading stays unlimited. See the App Store listing for current prices and details.
6780724192.privacy: OCR runs entirely on your iPhone with Apple Vision, works offline, and photos and text are never sent to a server. From version 1.8, images you are working on (including straightened document images) are kept temporarily on your device and deleted when they are no longer needed: when a read fails or is redone, when you close the result, or when you delete it from history; anything left over is removed the next time the app starts. Suggested fixes for misread text are made by Apple's on-device AI on supported iPhones, and neither photos nor text leave your device. Saved history keeps recognized text, line corrections, confidence values, and thumbnails locally in the app. There is no account, no ads, and no tracking. Sharing text is always user-initiated through the iOS share sheet. Subscription purchases are handled by the App Store and your Apple Account.

faq.question: Is OCR Copy free?
faq.answer: It is free to download and lets you read text up to 5 times a day. OCR Copy Pro, an auto-renewing yearly (with a 1-week free trial) or monthly subscription, removes the daily limit. If you used OCR Copy before version 1.5, reading stays unlimited. Check the App Store listing for current prices.

faq.question: What does OCR Copy Pro add?
faq.answer: It removes the daily limit of 5 reads in the app, the share sheet, and Shortcuts. Copying, saving, and CSV export never count toward the limit, and the count starts over at midnight.

faq.question: Are my photos or text uploaded anywhere?
faq.answer: No. Text recognition runs on your iPhone with Apple Vision, and photos and text are never sent to a server. There is no account, no ads, and no tracking.

faq.question: Can I read many images at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Select up to 20 photos or screenshots and OCR Copy reads them in the order you picked them and combines the text into one result.

faq.question: What languages can it read?
faq.answer: Auto reads your device's language first. You can also choose Japanese, English, Korean, Chinese, European languages, Russian, Ukrainian, Thai, or Vietnamese. The app itself is available in 25 languages.

faq.question: What if the OCR result has mistakes?
faq.answer: You can fix or delete individual lines before copying. Lines with low confidence are flagged for review when detail display is enabled.

faq.question: Can I save text and come back to it later?
faq.answer: Yes. Saved text is stored locally on your device and appears on the Home screen, where you can reopen and copy it again anytime.

faq.question: Does it read handwriting or vertical Japanese text?
faq.answer: The app targets printed text in photos and camera shots. Vertical Japanese text and complex layouts may not be read correctly.

faq.question: Do I need camera access?
faq.answer: Camera access is needed for live scan and camera capture, but you can also pick existing images from your photo library or share them to OCR Copy.

ja.name: OCRコピー - 画像を文字起こし
ja.short_description: 写真・スクショ・カメラの文字を読み取ってコピー。最大20枚まとめて文字起こしでき、認識はiPhone内で行います。
ja.meta_description: OCRコピーは、写真・スクリーンショット・カメラの文字をコピーできるテキストにするアプリ。最大20枚まで一括で文字起こし、端末内で処理、オフライン対応です。
overview: OCRコピーは、画像や目の前の文字をすばやくコピーするためのローカル完結型OCRアプリです。写真やスクリーンショットを最大20枚まとめて選ぶと、選んだ順に読み取って1つのテキストにまとめます。ライブスキャンやカメラ撮影のほか、写真アプリや撮ったスクショの「共有」から選んでも、読み取った文字はすぐクリップボードに入ります。レシート、本、荷物のラベル、スクリーンショット、看板など、日常の文字に使えます。

重いドキュメント管理アプリやクラウドOCRサービスではなく、「読み取って、コピーして、終わり」という小さな仕事に絞りました。文字の読み取りはApple Visionで iPhone の中だけで行い、写真やテキストを外部サーバーへ送信しません。認識結果が完璧でないときは、コピーする前に行単位で修正・削除できます。信頼度や文字位置は、必要な人だけが見られる詳細情報として用意しています。表が写った画像は行と列のままCSVファイルに書き出せ（iOS 26以降）、ショートカットの「画像の文字を読む」アクションで画像の文字を受け取ることもできます。
保存したテキストは端末内に残り、後から開いてもう一度コピーできます。「自動」は端末の言語を優先して読み取り、読み取り言語として日本語・英語・韓国語・中国語・ヨーロッパの言語・ロシア語・ウクライナ語・タイ語・ベトナム語も選べます。無料では1日5回まで読み取れ、OCRコピー Pro で1日の回数制限がなくなります。
target_users: レシートや荷物、本、紙の書類の文字を打ち直すことが多い方
スクリーンショットや写真の文字を、クラウドサービスを使わずに、まとめて取り出したい方
多言語の文字を扱うため、OCRの対象言語を選びたい方
画像に写った表をCSVファイルにしたい方
写真やテキストをサーバーに送りたくない、プライバシー重視の方
features: まとめて文字起こし: 写真やスクショを最大20枚選んで、選んだ順に1つのテキストに
共有からすぐ文字に: 写真アプリや撮ったスクショの「共有」からOCRコピーを選ぶと、その場で文字にしてコピー
表をCSVに: 表が写った画像を、行と列のままCSVファイルに書き出し（iOS 26以降）
ショートカット: 「画像の文字を読む」アクションで、画像の文字をテキストとして受け取れる
ライブスキャン: カメラをかざして文字をコピー。カメラで撮影して文字をコピーすることも
Apple Visionによる端末内の文字認識。オフラインで使え、サーバーは使いません

overview: Blur Before Share hides faces, names, addresses, license plates, and anything else you do not want to show, right before you share a photo. Draw with your finger over the parts to hide, pick an effect, and save or share the result. Your original photo is never changed.

Pick the effect that fits what you are hiding: blur to softly hide faces and backgrounds, mosaic with large pixel blocks that keep the photo looking natural, or a solid black cover, the surest choice for text. You can mix all three in one photo. When you open a photo, Cover Faces finds faces on your device and covers them automatically; tap the × to uncover any one of them.

The copy you save or share is re-rendered from scratch, so it carries no location (GPS) or camera metadata from the original. There is no account, no upload, and no ads. Every tool is free, and you can save or share up to 3 blurred photos a day for free. Blur Before Share Pro removes the daily limit. The app is available in 25 languages.

6789844158.short_description: Remove sound from any video in one tap, or beep out selected parts — from the share sheet too. No re-encoding, no watermark.
6789844158.meta_description: Mute Video Before Share removes sound from a video in one tap, even from the share sheet, or beeps out selected parts. No quality loss, no watermark.
overview: Mute Video Before Share removes the audio track from a video so you can share it without background voices, conversations, or noise. Pick a video, tap once, and get a silent copy ready to post or send — while your original video stays completely unchanged. You can also choose Mute & Share straight from the share sheet to make a silent copy without opening the app.

Unlike video editors that re-encode everything, this app copies the video track as-is and simply drops the audio. That means zero picture-quality loss, fast results even on long videos, no length limit, and no watermark. If you only need to hide part of the sound, you can replace selected parts with a beep, using the sound's waveform to spot where people are talking.

The silent copy is also cleaner than the original in one important way: it contains no location or camera metadata from the source video, so you are not leaking where a clip was filmed when you share it. The app is available in 25 languages and works in portrait and landscape on iPhone, and on iPad.

ja.name: 動画の音消し

overview: 「動画の音消し」は、動画から音声トラックだけを取り除き、無音のコピーを作るアプリです。後ろの会話や生活音、風の音が入ってしまった動画も、動画を選んでワンタップするだけで、そのままSNSに投稿したり送ったりできる状態になります。元の動画は一切変更されません。共有メニューから「音を消して共有」を選べば、アプリを開かずに無音コピーを作れます。
一般的な動画編集アプリとちがい、映像を再エンコードせずにそのままコピーして音声だけを外す方式のため、画質の劣化はゼロです。長い動画でも高速に処理でき、長さ制限も透かし（ウォーターマーク）もありません。一部の音だけ隠したいときは、選んだ区間をピー音に置き換えられ、音の波形を見ながら話し声の位置を探せます。
作成された無音コピーには、元動画の位置情報や撮影情報が引き継がれません。どこで撮影したかを知られずに共有できるという点でも、投稿前のひと手間として役立ちます。25言語に対応し、iPhoneでは縦向き・横向きどちらでも、iPadでも使えます。

overview: ExifOff checks what a photo reveals and creates a clean copy for safer sharing. Pick a photo to see whether it contains location data (and where it was taken, on a map), along with basics like date taken, camera, image size, original file type, and file size - then create a new copy with the metadata removed before you post or send it. 6789844298.short_description: A meal photo diary that turns your food photos into a calendar of everyday memories. Just take a photo; add a dish name or calorie note only when you want to.
6789844298.meta_description: GohanSnap is a food photo diary for iPhone: snap your meals, see them on a calendar, and add a dish name or calorie note only if you like. No ads.
overview: GohanSnap is a food photo diary that turns your meal photos into a calendar of everyday memories. Just take a photo with the camera or pick one from your library - the entry takes its time from the photo, and breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snack is chosen from that time (you can change it later). Dish names and calorie notes are optional: add them only when you want to.

It is a record, not a diet coach. The daily calorie total adds up only the values you entered, you set your own daily calorie goal (the app does not recommend one), and it does not judge meals as good or bad. Add from Photos finds meal photos on your device so you can record several at once, and you can still record a dish name or note without a photo. Entries can be tagged Home cooking, Eating out, or Takeout, saved as My Items to record the same meal again, searched, and exported as CSV.

Look back with a monthly calendar and daily list, this month's summary and your recording streak, a Home Screen widget, and optional breakfast, lunch, and dinner reminders (off by default). You can share your month in meals as one image, and export entries and photos together as a backup file. Your entries are stored on your device, with no ads and no account. This app does not provide medical or nutritional advice.
target_users: People who gave up on strict calorie-counting apps but still want to remember what they ate
Anyone who wants a visual meal diary with the lowest possible effort
People reviewing their eating patterns by looking back over a calendar of photos
Users who want to prepare a question about their meals for an AI app they already use
Privacy-conscious users who want food records kept on their phone
features: Record a meal from the camera or photo library; the time comes from the photo and the meal type (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack) is picked automatically

On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, a short on-device caption for each photo - it never estimates calories and can be turned off
Optional Apple Health integration: writes only the calories you enter, never reads Health data, off by default
Choose what to ask an AI, then hand the question and photos to the external AI app you use - the app never sends anything to an AI service on its own
Monthly calendar, daily list, monthly summary, recording streak, shareable month image, Home Screen widget, and optional reminders (off by default)
Backup of entries and photos in one file via Files or AirDrop; entries are stored on your device, with no ads and no account
how_to_use: Open the app when you eat and take a photo, or pick one from your library (or use Add from Photos to record several at once).
The meal type is chosen from the photo's time - change it if you like.
Add a dish name, calories, or a note only when you want to; tap a photo later to edit details.
Look back over the monthly calendar and daily list, and check this month's summary and your recording streak.
Optionally turn on reminders, Apple Health, or photo saving in Settings (all off by default), or export a backup file.

Photo captions are made on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence. See the App Store privacy label for the current details.

faq.question: Is GohanSnap free?
faq.answer: Yes. The app is free with no ads and no account required. App Store pricing can change, so check the listing for current details.

faq.question: Does it count calories or analyze nutrition?
faq.answer: Not for you. Calories are optional notes you enter yourself, and the daily total adds up only those values. The app never estimates calories, does not recommend a goal, and does not judge meals as good or bad - it is a record, not a diet coach.

faq.question: Where is my meal data stored?
faq.answer: On your device. Entries are stored locally, and writing to Apple Health happens only when you turn it on. There is no account. You can also export entries and photos as a backup file.

faq.question: Is there AI in the app?
faq.answer: No AI service is used by the app on its own. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence it can add a short caption to each photo, made on your device. You can also prepare a question and hand it, with your photos, to an external AI app you use, such as ChatGPT or Claude.

faq.question: How do I record a meal?
faq.answer: Take a photo with the camera or pick one from your library. The time comes from the photo and the meal type is chosen from it. Add a dish name, calories, or a note later if you like - or record without a photo.

faq.question: Does it help me keep the habit going?
faq.answer: Gently. It shows your recording streak and a short monthly summary, and offers optional breakfast, lunch, and dinner reminders (off by default) and a Home Screen widget.

faq.question: Is this app available in English?
faq.answer: Yes. GohanSnap is available in English, Japanese, and many other languages - more than 20 in total. Check the App Store listing for the current list.

faq.question: Does it work with Apple Health?
faq.answer: Optionally. When you turn it on, the app writes only the calories you enter to Apple Health as dietary energy. It does not read any Health data, and it is off by default.

6789844338.meta_description: Korean Travel Phrase Card shows 106 offline Korean (Hangul) travel phrases on iPhone. Search in Japanese, show large text, play speech. No ads.
overview: Korean Travel Phrase Card is a practical phrase card app for travelers visiting Korea, designed especially for Japanese speakers. Instead of memorizing Korean, you search for a phrase, open it, and show large Korean text to a local person - or play the phrase aloud, at normal speed or slowly, using the iPhone's built-in text-to-speech.

It is a phrase card app, not a language-learning app, and it does not translate text you enter. All 106 phrases across 13 travel categories are bundled inside the app, so everything works offline from the moment you land - no account, no ads, no external translation API. You can also save Korean text you prepared, such as an address or allergy note, as a My Card.

Phrases are organized by real travel situations - basics and greetings, restaurants, cafes, shopping, cosmetics and beauty, hotels, transportation, payment, photo requests, sightseeing, fan events, health and allergies, and trouble - and ordered by practical usefulness so the phrases you actually need come first.

Travelers who want to communicate about allergies or health issues clearly

Large Show mode for presenting the Korean phrase to a local person, with even larger text when you turn your iPhone sideways

Favorite the phrases you use often so they are one tap away next time, or save your own Korean text as a My Card.

faq.question: Is Korean Travel Phrase Card free?
faq.answer: Yes. The app is free with no ads and no in-app purchases. App Store pricing can change, so check the listing for current details.

faq.answer: None. There is no account, no analytics, no ads, and no tracking. Your favorite phrases and My Cards are stored only on your device.

faq.question: What situations do the phrases cover?
faq.answer: 13 categories: basics and greetings, restaurants, cafes, shopping, cosmetics and beauty, hotels, transportation, payment, photo requests, sightseeing, fan events, health and allergies, and trouble.

faq.answer: The app plays Korean phrases using the iPhone's built-in text-to-speech system (AVSpeechSynthesizer), at normal speed or slowly when a Korean voice is available. No audio is recorded and no external service is used.

faq.question: Can I rely on it for emergencies?

6789844342.short_description: Turn web pages and copied text into clean Markdown clips - saved on your device, ready to paste anywhere.
6789844342.meta_description: ClipMD converts web pages and copied text into clean Markdown on iPhone. Clip via URL or share sheet, keep clips locally, and paste into any notes app.
overview: ClipMD turns web pages and copied text into clean Markdown clips you keep on your device. Paste a URL or share a page to ClipMD, and it extracts the article body and converts it to Markdown - headings, lists, and links preserved - ready to paste into your notes app or keep as a reading archive.

It is a focused clipping tool, not a read-it-later service or a browser replacement. You can save .md files to a folder you choose (such as an Obsidian vault), copy an AI-ready version with summary and body sections, search your clips, and convert URLs or clipboard text from Apple Shortcuts. There is no account, no cloud sync, and no telemetry; the only network requests it makes are fetching the exact pages you ask it to convert.
Made for note-takers who live in Markdown: clip it now, paste it anywhere later.
target_users: Writers and researchers collecting article snippets for reference
Developers who keep notes and documentation in Markdown
Obsidian, Bear, and other Markdown notes app users who want clean paste-ready text
Anyone tired of copy-pasting web articles and losing headings, lists, and links
Privacy-conscious users who want clips stored locally, not on someone's server

Clip directly from Safari or other apps via the share sheet
Convert copied text to Markdown in one tap
Clean extraction focused on the article body, with headings, lists, and links preserved

Save .md files to a chosen folder or Obsidian vault
Copy an AI-ready version with clear summary and body sections
Convert URLs or clipboard text from Apple Shortcuts
All clips stored locally on your device; network used only to fetch pages you request
how_to_use: Find a page worth keeping - in Safari, tap Share and choose ClipMD, or copy the URL.
In the app, paste the URL (or your copied text) and let ClipMD extract the article body.
Review the generated Markdown - headings, lists, and links come through intact.
Save it as a clip, then copy or share it into your notes app whenever you need it.
Edit or delete clips from the list; your archive stays on your device.
6789844342.pricing: ClipMD is free on the App Store, with no ads. App Store pricing and availability can change, so check the store listing for current details.
6789844342.privacy: Clips, titles, and settings are stored locally on your device and are never uploaded to the developer or any third party. There is no account, no analytics, no tracking, no ads, no crash reporting, and no third-party SDKs. Network access is user-initiated only: when you give ClipMD a URL, it fetches that page directly from the site you specified and makes no other requests. Uninstalling the app removes all stored data.

faq.question: Is ClipMD free?
faq.answer: Yes. ClipMD is free on the App Store with no ads. Pricing can change, so check the listing for current details.

faq.question: Where are my clips stored?
faq.answer: Only on your device (including App Group storage shared with the share extension). Nothing is uploaded to the developer or any third party, and uninstalling the app removes all stored data. If you choose to save .md files to a folder, those files are saved where you pick.

faq.question: Does ClipMD connect to the internet?

faq.answer: ClipMD extracts the article body and preserves structure - headings, lists, and links - so the clip pastes cleanly into any Markdown notes app.

faq.question: Does it sync between devices?
faq.answer: No. There is no cloud sync or account; clips live on the device where you saved them. You can copy or share a clip, or save it as a .md file, to move it elsewhere.

faq.answer: Yes. Any clip can be copied, shared, edited, or deleted from the clip list, and you can search your clips by title and text.

6791862183.short_description: A daily number puzzle and quick brain game: forge six numbers with + - x / into the target and keep your streak alive.
6791862183.meta_description: Number Forge is a daily number puzzle for iPhone: combine six numbers with + - x / to hit the target, chase par, climb the daily leaderboard, keep a streak
overview: Number Forge is a daily number puzzle. Every day brings exactly one new puzzle: combine six numbers using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to forge the target number. Pick two tiles and an operation, forge them into a new number, and work your way to the target in as few operations as you can.

Because there is only one puzzle per day and everyone in the world gets the same one, it becomes a short daily brain habit rather than an endless time sink. Par shows the minimum possible number of operations, so even after you solve it there's a reason to think harder. Once you solve it, see where you stand on the optional Game Center daily leaderboard (scores start at 2,000), and look for other ways to forge the target to raise your title for the day. Streaks, par-match counts, and spoiler-free result sharing keep the habit going.

Not quite there? You can finish whenever you like: within 10 of the target earns 2 stars and within 25 earns 1 star, and stars keep your streak going. Once you have finished, you can see an example solution, and finishing today's puzzle also unlocks practice on earlier dates. A Home Screen widget (small and medium) shows today's target before you solve, or your result after, and an optional once-a-day reminder helps you keep the chain. The app and widget are available in the 13 App Store languages.
target_users: Fans of daily puzzle games like Wordle or NYT Digits looking for a numbers version
People who want a short, sharp mental-math workout with morning coffee or on the commute
Puzzle players who enjoy chasing the optimal solution, not just any solution
Streak keepers who like building an unbroken daily record
Anyone who wants a quality brain game with no ads, no account, and no tracking
features: One new puzzle every day - the same puzzle for every player worldwide
Forge mechanic: pick two tiles and an operation (+ - x /) to combine them, with undo and reset
Par shows the minimum possible operations - match it if you can
Daily Forge leaderboard on Game Center: scores start at 2,000, minus 200 per move over par and 1 per second (time stops counting at 20 minutes); sign-in is optional
Finish whenever you like: 2 stars within 10 of the target, 1 star within 25, and stars keep your streak going; see an example solution afterwards
Find other ways to forge the target after solving to raise your daily title: Apprentice, Smith, Master Smith, Legend
Practice earlier puzzles on your device after finishing today's; practice never affects rankings, streaks, titles, or stats
Stats: solved days, current streak, longest streak, and par matches
Spoiler-free share text with puzzle number, operation count, and streak
Small and medium Home Screen widgets showing today's target or your solved result
Optional daily reminder notification; fully playable without it
No account, no ads, no tracking; the app and widget are available in 13 languages
how_to_use: Open the app - today's puzzle appears immediately, no onboarding, no menus.
Pick two number tiles and an operation to forge them into a new number.
Keep combining until you hit the target; use undo or reset if you take a wrong turn. If you cannot get there, you can finish whenever you like and still earn stars.
Try to match par - the minimum possible number of operations.
After solving, check your place on the Daily Forge leaderboard (optional Game Center sign-in), look for other ways to reach the target, and share your result as spoiler-free text.
Come back tomorrow for the next puzzle and keep your streak alive - the widget shows the new target at a glance.
6791862183.pricing: Number Forge is free on the App Store, with no ads and no in-app purchases. App Store pricing and features can change, so check the store listing for current details.
6791862183.privacy: No account is required, and there are no ads and no tracking. Your progress - solved days, streaks, and settings - is stored locally on your device (shared with the widget via an App Group, on-device only), with no iCloud sync and no server of our own. Signing in to Game Center is optional; only if you do, your daily score is sent to Game Center for the leaderboard, and everything else works without it. The optional daily reminder is a local notification.

faq.question: Is Number Forge free?
faq.answer: Yes. The app is free with no ads and no in-app purchases. App Store pricing can change, so check the listing for current details.

faq.question: How does the daily puzzle work?
faq.answer: Each day there is one new puzzle, generated from the date, and every player in the world gets the same one. You combine six numbers with + - x / to reach the target number.

faq.question: What is par?
faq.answer: Par is the minimum possible number of operations for that day's puzzle. Solving is one thing - matching par is the real challenge, and the app counts your par matches over time.

faq.question: How does the daily leaderboard work?
faq.answer: After you solve today's puzzle, you can see "Today: #N of M" on the Game Center Daily Forge leaderboard. Scores start at 2,000, minus 200 per move over par and 1 per second (time stops counting at 20 minutes). Game Center sign-in is optional, and everything works without it.

faq.question: What if I cannot reach the target?
faq.answer: You can finish whenever you like. Within 10 of the target earns 2 stars and within 25 earns 1 star, and stars keep your streak going. Afterwards you can see an example solution.

faq.question: Can I play earlier puzzles?
faq.answer: Yes. After you finish today's puzzle, you can practice earlier dates on your device. Practice never affects rankings, streaks, titles, or stats.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: Puzzles are generated on your device, so you can play offline. Only the optional Game Center leaderboard needs a connection.

faq.question: Is there a widget?
faq.answer: Yes, in small and medium sizes. Before you solve, it shows today's target with a quick way into the game; after you solve, it shows your result. It updates at midnight for the next puzzle.

faq.question: What data does the app collect?
faq.answer: There is no account, no ads, and no tracking. Your streaks and results stay on your device. Only if you sign in to Game Center, your daily score is sent to Game Center for the leaderboard.

faq.question: Will it send me notifications?
faq.answer: Only if you turn on the optional once-a-day reminder. The app works fully without notifications.

ja.short_description: 1日1問の数字パズル。6つの数字を足す・引く・掛ける・割るで組み合わせて目標の数を作る、毎日の頭の体操です。
ja.meta_description: かず鍛冶は1日1問の数字パズル。6つの数字を+−×÷で組み合わせて目標の数を作る、暗算向きの脳トレ。最少手数「パー」や連続記録、きょうのランキングに挑戦できます。
overview: かず鍛冶は、1日1問だけの数字パズルです。毎日新しい問題が1問届き、6つの数字を足す・引く・掛ける・割るで組み合わせて目標の数を作ります。数字を2つ選んで演算を選ぶと新しい数字が生まれるので、できるだけ少ない手数で目標にたどり着きましょう。

問題は毎日1問だけで、世界中のプレイヤーが同じ問題に挑戦します。だらだら遊び続けるゲームではなく、短い「毎日の頭の体操」として続けられる設計です。「パー」は理論上の最少手数。解けたあとも「パーで解けるか」というもうひと粘りの楽しみがあります。解いたあとは、任意のGame Centerで「きょうのランキング」の順位（2000点満点）を確かめたり、ほかの作り方を探して今日の称号を上げたりできます。連続記録やパー達成数の記録、ネタバレなしの結果シェアが習慣を後押しします。

惜しくても大丈夫。いつでも「ここで終える」ことができ、目標との差が10以内なら星2つ、25以内なら星1つ、星がつけば連続記録は続きます。終えたあとは答えの例を見られ、今日の問題を終えると前の日付の問題も練習できます。ホーム画面ウィジェット（小・中サイズ）では、解く前は今日の目標の数を、クリア後は結果をひと目で確認でき、任意の1日1回リマインダーにも対応します。アプリとウィジェットはストアと同じ13言語に対応しています。
target_users: WordleやNYT Digitsのようなデイリーパズルが好きで、数字版を探している方
朝のコーヒータイムや通勤時間に、短くて手応えのある計算トレーニングをしたい方
ただ解くだけでなく、最少手数の解を追いかけたいパズル好きの方
連続記録を途切れさせずに積み上げるのが好きな方
広告なし・アカウント不要・トラッキングなしの脳トレアプリを求めている方

ja.privacy: アカウント登録は不要で、広告もトラッキングもありません。クリア日数・連続記録・設定などの記録は端末内にのみ保存され（ウィジェットとの共有も端末内のApp Group経由）、iCloud同期や独自のサーバーはありません。Game Centerへのサインインは任意で、サインインした場合にのみ、きょうのランキング用に当日のスコアがGame Centerへ送られます。それ以外はサインインなしで使えます。リマインダーは任意のローカル通知です。

faq.question: かず鍛冶は無料ですか？
faq.answer: はい。広告なし・アプリ内課金なしで無料です。価格は変わる可能性があるため、最新の情報はApp Storeでご確認ください。

faq.question: 毎日の問題はどういう仕組みですか？
faq.answer: 問題は日付から生成され、毎日1問だけ。世界中のプレイヤーが同じ問題に挑戦します。6つの数字を+−×÷で組み合わせて目標の数を作ります。

faq.question: 「パー」とは何ですか？
faq.answer: その日の問題を解くのに必要な理論上の最少手数です。解くだけでなくパーと同じ手数でクリアできるかが本当の挑戦で、パー達成数はアプリが記録してくれます。

faq.question: きょうのランキングはどういう仕組みですか？
faq.answer: 今日の問題を解くと、Game Centerの「今日のフォージ」で「今日 N位 / M人」と表示されます。2000点満点で、パー超過は1手ごとに−200点、時間は1秒ごとに−1点（20分で打ち切り）です。サインインは任意で、しなくても全機能を使えます。

faq.question: 目標に届かないときはどうなりますか？
faq.answer: いつでも「ここで終える」ことができます。目標との差が10以内なら星2つ、25以内なら星1つで、星がつけば連続記録は続きます。終えたあとは答えの例を見られます。

faq.question: 過去の問題も遊べますか？
faq.answer: はい。今日の問題を終えると、前の日付の問題を端末内で練習できます。順位・連続・称号・統計には数えません。

faq.question: オフラインでも遊べますか？
faq.answer: 問題は端末内で生成されるので、オフラインでも遊べます。通信が必要なのは、任意のGame Centerランキングだけです。

faq.question: ウィジェットはありますか？
faq.answer: はい、小・中サイズがあります。解く前は今日の目標の数を、解いたあとは結果を表示し、日付が変わると次の問題に更新されます。

faq.question: アプリはどんなデータを集めますか？
faq.answer: アカウントも広告もトラッキングもありません。連続記録や結果は端末内にのみ保存されます。Game Centerにサインインした場合にのみ、ランキング用に当日のスコアがGame Centerへ送られます。

faq.question: 通知は届きますか？
faq.answer: 任意の1日1回リマインダーをオンにした場合のみ届きます。通知なしでも全機能を使えます。
